method: RealityKit photogrammetry from 169 unique, exact-time frames of the supplied video; disconnected sky fragment and ground capture removed. Straight plinth faces repaired at the recovered dimensions, with photographic UVs sampled from the original scan. Sculptural anatomy is not manually deformed.

plinth.textureMethod: Planar atlas baked per texel from the source scan to preserve UV seams

geometryNote: Source-derived soldiers, faces, hands, weapons, drapery and banner. Overall orientation, translation and uniform scale only. Unobserved upper/rear banner surfaces may contain reconstruction error; this is not a measured survey. Plinth surface repair is approximate.
dedication: Ваш подвиг будет жить вечно в памяти белорусского народа
geometryRepair: Three small source boundary edges and the hidden basal cut capped; no anatomical deformation
